claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA, split into 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% administration fee to Minswap Labs.

The delivery budget is allocated as 300,000 ADA for the DeFi Kernel registry website and submission process, 1,000,000 ADA for Spot Leverage Order Book, 1,000,000 ADA for American Options Protocol, and 1,000,000 ADA for the SDK.

Dano Finance will deliver a public DeFi Kernel registry that documents compatibility requirements, metadata, script hashes, schemas, integration steps, audit or security status, and related registry information for compatible contracts.
Dano Finance will deliver two DeFi Kernel-compatible primitives: a Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options Market-Making Pools.

Dano Finance will deliver a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK to help wallets, bots, indexers, market makers, and dApps discover metadata, parse schemas, construct transactions, and integrate with compatible contracts.
The proposer states that Dano Finance currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.

The proposal claims Cardano DeFi is fragmented across liquidity, metadata, and execution paths, and that the DeFi Kernel would improve discoverability, composability, liquidity, integrations, and recurring on-chain activity.

Mainnet releases for the Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options Protocol are conditioned on security review or audit, issue resolution, published script hashes and schemas, and DeFi Kernel compatibility documentation.

The proposal sets KPIs including USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of each mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees from the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, and report this publicly.

summary: The proposal is a 3,333,000 ADA treasury request for DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with milestone structure, security review conditions, public reporting, KPI targets, Minswap Labs administration, and a 12-month 5% protocol-fee return commitment.
